'''Raven Squad''' was a prestigious [[Imperial Special Forces (Sith Empire)|Special Forces]] [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] that was deployed on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref name="Anri">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Major Anri}}</ref> The highly esteemed [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was based in [[Strike Base XR-484]] and was lead by its [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Strike Base XR-484}}</ref>

==Organization==
Although [[Darth Malora]] was originally in charge of the invasion force, her [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]] experiments with the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] greatly jeopardized the lives of the Imperials. This left Malora not popular among Raven Squad; its [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]] especially had a very low opinion of her.

Raven Squad members consistently referred to the base as "the Nest," a term that Darth Malora pointedly refused to use during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref name="Codex" />

[[File:Raven_Squad.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Major Anri and the Raven Squad]]
On behalf of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] leading figure, [[Darth Malgus]] was dispatched to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and assumed command over the entire invasion force. Raven Squad hailed the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] as a war hero, and assisted during the attack on the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]].
